name: unfold

themes.name: Day
themes.usage: Warm sand and ink, never white. The landing's sunrise end state (--day: 1).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and window background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tiles and quiet panels set on the ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, menus and popovers set on the ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and tile borders.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Wordmark, headings and body on ground, surface and surface-raised. Ivory at night, ink by day.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: The OPEN INTELLIGENCE tag and secondary copy on ground and surface.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Labels and captions on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ground-glow
tokens.usage: The ground once the day has fully brightened (--glow: 1 on the landing). Optional second step of the day.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Solid fill of the primary pill and pressed toggles. Text on it is `ground`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: See-through card ground over the particle field. Border it with `line`.

tokens.name: card-active
tokens.usage: A card that is selected or joined; pair with a `text-faint` border. The day value is derived; the site has no day variant yet.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Behind text blocks that sit over a busy field in the day, so lines stay readable.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Top bar once scrolled: `ground` at 82% with `blur(14px) saturate(120%)` behind it.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one UI accent: where you are (the nav indicator, the current menu item), the Proposal state, hover on a featured card. Never in the mark, never for running text.

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: Border of a gold state chip.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done / available. Same hue as spectrum-sea. Shown as a filled 10px dot.

tokens.name: status-road
tokens.usage: On the road / in progress. Same hue as spectrum-violet. Filled dot.

tokens.name: status-open
tokens.usage: Open / not started. Shown as a 1.5px ring, not a fill.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Light ink: the one-colour mark on dark grounds. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Dark ink: the one-colour mark on light grounds and for print. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: spectrum-coral
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-ember
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-rose
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-pink
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-orchid
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-lilac
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-violet
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-blue
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-sky
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-cyan
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-sea
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

tokens.name: spectrum-green
tokens.usage: Mark, particle field and data marks only, never text. Part of the twelve-hue spectrum with no yellow.

palettes.name: arc
palettes.usage: The seven-step arc, root to crown: a faint radial wash (8.5% opacity) behind a long scroll and the 5px rail of points at the right edge. Never named on the page.

palettes.name: capacity
palettes.usage: Six kinds of contribution (machines, operations, training …) in the capacity drawing and its legend.

palettes.name: spectrum
palettes.usage: The twelve hues in mark order, for the particle field and the mark. Mix between them in OKLab.

palettes.name: tactu
palettes.usage: Tactu's own brand, only inside Tactu pieces: shell, bands, head, ground.

reader.usage: Reading surfaces (the manifesto reader): a separate set, so long text can sit on its own light. Reader day is paper, not the page's sand.

size.steps: The reader lets people step the size; 20px is the default.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the top bar: “we” upright, “unfold” italic, always lowercase. Scale it up freely for covers.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The first screen only. One per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Scene and page titles (landing h2, subpage h1). Italic for the one word that turns.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings on subpages and in app views.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: AI that belongs to humanity, built in the open.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a title, in `text`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We unfold is a movement for open intelligence.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above a title, in `text-faint`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Pills, nav links and menu items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Meta lines, counters, times, small chips (0.1–0.22em by density).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Legends, hashes, numbers and segmented controls.

spacing.note: Fibonacci steps in px. Every gap, padding and margin on the landing is one of these (13, 21 and 8 are the most used).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: Inner gaps of tiles.

tokens.name: space-21
tokens.usage: Gaps between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-34
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-55
tokens.usage: Wide column gaps (map, grids).

tokens.name: space-89
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of each section.

gutter.usage: Side gutter at every width; content max-width 1280px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, segmented controls. The system is square; only pills and circles curve.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: The 2px gold indicator line.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, toggle buttons, state chips, the floating counter.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Dots, the mark, avatars.

source: Extracted from the weunfold landing page (site/index.html, content/partials/header.css, site/assets/sub.css). The landing is the source of truth; edit here, then run `node design-system/build.mjs`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and divider. No shadows.

tokens.name: dashed
tokens.usage: Something not there yet: a fold to find, a ‘Soon’ chip.

motion.note: Things settle; nothing bounces. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop transitions, nothing autoplays, scenes rest on a still frame.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour, labels appearing.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Borders, backgrounds, the top bar ground.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: The gold indicator sliding between items.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Fades of whole elements, the aura.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: Cross-page view transitions.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity changes.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Anything that changes place or size.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content width.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: A text column beside a visual.

tokens.name: prose
tokens.usage: Reading width for paragraphs.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height (36px mark, 24px wordmark).

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything you press (40px inside the bar).
